tenderSchedule.locationName: GESCOM Superintending Engineer Projects Corporate Office Gulbarga

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Remaining Condition as per bid document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

The bidder should have satisfactorily completed 80 Percentage of the contract value (APT) works such as SRTPV works/ground mounted solar works along with work involving cable laying or RMU and HT Metering Cubicle commissioned in any of DISCOM/Power Utilities/SEBs/ Government Entities in India as on the date of bid submission in any ONE year of the preceding Five Financial Years (FY 2021-22 to 2025-26) Document required: Work Done Certificate issued by EE or above rank Purchase Orders, Detailed Work Award

The bidder should have executed 50 Percentage of SRTPV of this package tendered such as Providing SRTPV to the Govt or Pvt Installations/ground mounted solar plants in any one year during the last Five Years FY 2021-22 to 2025-26 in any ESCOM/ DISCOMs/power utilities/SEB/ government entities/Private in India on TTK/PTK basis Document required: Performance Certificate issued by EE & above rank officer in Annexure C Format for having installed SRTPV unit of minimum 434kWp shall be uploaded

The Annual Turnover (ATO) of the bidder should not be less than two times Amount Put to Tender in any two financial year of the preceding five financial years (i.e. FY 2021-22 to 2025-26 Document required Audited financial statements for FY22 to FY26 with turnover profit loss details signed by proprietor or director certified by CA with UDIN No

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of the bidder should not be less than 25 Percentage of amount put to tender as on date of submission of bid consisting of cash at Bank plus availability of fund based credit facility in any Nationalized/scheduled commercial Bank Document required Liquid Assets certificate issued by Nationalized/ scheduled commercial Bank shall be uploaded in the format enclosed as Annexure A
Bidder can be a sole/single business entity, Government Owned entity
technicalCriterionList.criterionTypeOthersValue: Bidder can be a sole/single business entity, Government Owned entity

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Registration document in case of sole/ Single business entity  shall be uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should be in existence as any of the following a)Body incorporated in India under the Companies Act, 1956/2013 including any amendment thereto b)Body incorporated in India under the Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Act, 2008 including any amendment thereto c)Firm registered under Partnership Act, 1932 in India d)Firm registered under Societies Registration Act, 1860/The Karnataka Societies Registration Act, 1960 in India e)Sole Proprietor incorporated in India f) Registered Class-1 or above grade licensed LEC Document required Certificate Incorporation issued by Registrar of Companies as per Companies Act 1956/2013 along with MOA and AOA OR The certificate issued by the registrar of firms as per Indian & Partnership Act 1932 OR The certificate issued by the registrar of Society as per Societies Act, 1860/1960 OR The registration certificate issued by Statutory Authority or Calss-1 LEC certificate issued by Electrical Inspectorate

The Bidder should possess or engage the services of Licensed Electrical Contractor having license of minimum Class-1/ Super grade license for Electrical works in Karnataka Document required: Bidder shall scan and upload the valid certificate of LEC

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- class 1 or super grade license

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall upload the valid document of EPF, ESI & GST registration certificate Document required: Document in Original shall be scanned and uploaded
All Self-declarations as per General Criteria of IFB 6 (C) shall be uploaded Document required: All Self-declarations as per General Criteria of IFB 6 (C) shall uploaded

The bidder has to furnish the details of works in hand as on date of submission of bids duly indicating date of award, awarded amount in percentage of work completion and work description which is to be certified by the officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer. In case if the financial progress of these works in hand are more than 70 percentage then, such works will not be reckoned while assessing the capability of bidder. The available tender capacity shall not be less than the Total Amount Put to Tender. The assessed available tender capacity AxNx1.5 minus B Where A Maximum value of Electrical Infrastructure works executed in any one year during the last 5 years (Updated to CSR 2025-26 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N Number of years prescribed for completion of works for which tenders are invited. B value at CSR 2025-26 price level of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next One years. The statement showing the value of existing commitments and ongoing works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed shall be counter signed by the employer in charge, not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent. Document required The statement shall be as per the format prescribed in Annexure-B and shall be uploaded in KPPP Portal. The bidder shall note that the value of pendency of work should be considered based on financial progress achieved in the particular work.

itemList.description: Supply of  Solar PV Modules of total 1 KWp capacity inclusive of all taxes and duties. Supply of Suitable size module mounting structure for 1 KWp capacity  inclusive of all taxes and duties. Supply of Required capacity cables & wiring accessories & manual disconnect switch as per IS standard for 1 KWp capacity  inclusive of all taxes and duties. Supply of Suitable AC distribution Box including accessories for 1 Kwp capacity  inclusive of all taxes and duties. Supply of Suitable DC distribution Box including accessories for 1 Kwp capacity  inclusive of all taxes and duties. Supply Earthing  for 1 Kwp capacity inclusive of all taxes and duties. Supply of lightning protection  for 1 Kwp capacity  inclusive of all taxes and duties. Supply of Suitable Array junction box with fuse & SPD including main array junction and sub array junction for 1 Kwp capacity  inclusive of all taxes and duties. Installation and Commissioning :  Installation, Testing & Commissioning of SRTPV Systems of 1 Kwp capacity  inclusive of all taxes and duties.
